fixes.explanation: Right, and it's all craftsmanship. God says He has filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God, "…with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship…" Then God lists the work: designing artistic works in gold, silver and bronze, cutting gemstones and carving wood (Exodus 31:4–5). Warfare never comes up, friend.

Eliab son of Helon is a name from the tribe of Zebulun (Numbers 1:9), and he isn't in this passage. Easy one to mix up, friend, with all those names flying around. The one God calls by name here is "…Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur…" He's from the tribe of Judah.
